prompts.title: Cambridge IELTS 13 Test 1 Task 1
prompts.prompt: The two maps below show road access to a city hospital in 2007 and in 2010. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

prompts.title: Cambridge IELTS 13 Test 2 Task 1
prompts.prompt: The chart below shows the percentage of households in owned and rented accommodation in England and Wales between 1918 and 2011. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

prompts.title: Cambridge IELTS 13 Test 3 Task 1
prompts.prompt: The bar chart below shows the top ten countries for the production and consumption of electricity in 2014. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

prompts.title: Cambridge IELTS 13 Test 4 Task 1
prompts.prompt: The plans below show the layout of a university’s sports centre now, and how it will look after redevelopment. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
